label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God formed man of the _____ of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verse: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
note: Adam's origin story — a handful of earth plus the breath of God equals a living soul.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Cast thy _____ upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
note: Cast it, don't carry it. Peter echoes this centuries later: 'casting all your care upon him.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the _____, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
verse: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
note: Gideon's 300 went to battle with trumpets, lamps, and breakable pitchers — the strangest arsenal in Israel's history.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered _____ fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
verse: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
note: Aaron's sons improvised at the altar the day the priesthood began; the very next verse shows how seriously God took it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that _____ closer than a brother.
verse: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
note: 'A friend that sticketh closer than a brother' — preachers have long heard Jesus in this one.
